method: One run per fixture in a fresh temporary directory. Time each LuaLaTeX subprocess launched by the production _compile_latex helper; total_seconds covers all passes. The N=100 untagged variant changes only tagging=on to tagging=off in the temporary rendered source. No production files or settings are changed.

convergence_diagnostic.fixture: branching N=10, 22 people, 11 families, 33 events, 2 synthetic 96x72 portraits, tagging on
convergence_diagnostic.method: Capture book.aux, book.toc and book.out after each pass of the production _compile_latex helper; compare extracted text and Poppler structure output from saved pass PDFs.
convergence_diagnostic.interpretation: Do not ignore @tag@LastPage when checking convergence. The official tagpdf tree code uses the recorded tagstruct count to determine structure-ID padding and the recorded tagmcabs count to assemble the ParentTree; the third pass reads the counts produced after the table of contents has been tagged.

section_profile_diagnostic.fixture: branching N=100, 202 people, 101 families, 303 events, 20 synthetic 96x72 portraits, tagging on
section_profile_diagnostic.method: Instrument a single first LuaLaTeX pass in a temporary rendered source with expl3 benchmark tic/toc pairs around the seven book sections and retain tagpdf finalization timing hooks. Section intervals include page breaks and shipout between their start and next section marker.
section_profile_diagnostic.interpretation: Family connections, the documentary appendix and person profiles account for most measured section time; final tagpdf tree writing takes about 3.28 seconds in this pass. This single instrumented pass is diagnostic only and does not establish a stable performance budget or isolate the cost of individual LaTeX operations.

comparison.reason: Poppler reports Tagged: no for the untagged diagnostic PDF. The experiment points to substantial time spent in tagged compilation, but disabling tagging loses the PDF structure required by the project.
